I teach applied, code-first courses: every topic is anchored in a dataset and a case, and students write code from the first session. Course material is shared with enrolled students through the institute's learning platform.

## Madras School of Economics (2026 onwards)

| Course | Programme and batch | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Statistics with R | M.Sc. Data Science 2026–28, Semester I | Probability, distributions, sampling, estimation and hypothesis testing, taught entirely through R on case datasets. |
| Introduction to Artificial Intelligence | M.Sc. Data Science 2026–28, Semester I | Search, constraint satisfaction, reasoning under uncertainty, and knowledge graphs, with Python notebooks. |
| Programming in SQL | MBA 2025–27, Term IV | Relational modelling and MySQL 8, from single-table queries to analytics-style window functions, with a short bridge to NoSQL and BI. |

## Beyond the classroom

### Course assistants

Students of Statistics with R and Introduction to Artificial Intelligence have a chat assistant that answers only from the course notes. [How it came together](posts/2026-11-course-chatbots/index.qmd).

### Learn by Playing

Free, story-based courses in statistics and SQL, open to anyone. [Start here](play.qmd).

## Supervision

At MSE I supervise postgraduate dissertations across the M.Sc. Data Science, MBA and MA programmes.

At IMI Bhubaneswar I supervised more than 40 master's projects, including the following:

- A study on consumer preferences towards online food delivery applications and their marketing strategies — Retesh Kumar, PGDM 2021–23
- A comparative study of factors influencing offline and online shopping in the pharmaceutical sector — Deberko Saha, PGDM 2021–23
- A study on consumer buying behaviour towards e-wallets — Pratyusha Mishra, PGDM 2021–23
- Impact of social media marketing on impulse buying behaviour — Kanika Bhattacharyya, PGDM 2021–23
- Factors affecting brand loyalty for toothpastes — Maitreya Sengupta, PGDM 2021–23

I also supervised multiple master's projects at IMT Ghaziabad, IIM Bodh Gaya and IFMR GSB, Krea University.

## Earlier courses

Business analytics, data management using SQL, management information systems, business intelligence and data science, and statistics for management, taught at IMI Bhubaneswar, IIM Bodh Gaya, IFMR GSB (Krea University) and IMT Ghaziabad between 2017 and 2026.

## Executive and faculty development

Management Development Programmes on data and business analytics for organisations including PwC, the Reserve Bank of India and GMR, and Faculty Development Programmes for faculty and research scholars from IITs, IIMs, IMT and other institutes. Details on the [Workshops](workshops.qmd) page.
